method: Read-only: opened menus, pages, and the Create Token dialog, then cancelled. No token was created, regenerated, or deleted; token count was unchanged.

findings.observed: User Profile menu (top right; the button shows the signed-in user's display name) > Access Tokens opens 'My Settings > Access Tokens' with a '+ Create Token' button. The dialog asks for Name, optional Description, and Scope (Read Access Only or Read and Write Access, none preselected).
Admin > Access Tokens opens 'Administration > Access Tokens', which lists all users' tokens with a Delete action and cannot create a token.

documentation_comparison.note: Docs say 'My Access Tokens' and 'Create New Token'; the live UI shows 'Access Tokens' and 'Create Token'.
'System > Access Tokens' matches only because 'System' is the sysadmin's display name on the user menu. Other users see their own name. It is not the Admin area.
Administrators manage, delete, and purge all users' tokens.

review.notes: Owner confirmed the path: User Profile menu (top right) > Access Tokens > Create Token. Already reflected in evaluation/guidance/access-token-menu.md and case feedback-sca-token-ui-path-001; no new feedback candidate.
